name: Salesforce
description: Salesforce CRM: query any object (SOQL), read, create and update records.
help: FASTEST: paste the Consumer Key + secret below, press Connect and approve in the browser. ALTERNATIVE (no browser): paste the username and password+security-token too and the plugin signs in with the password flow. For sandboxes change the login URL to https://test.salesforce.com.

fields.label: Username (only for password flow, blank when using Connect)
